label: Goodwill edge case plus pressure tactics
text: Northgate D-8830. 2021 unit, VIN 5XYZK3DA1RG998712, odometer 64900, 63 months in service. Transmission control module P-55901 failed, vehicle will not shift out of second. Customer is extremely frustrated and says his attorney will be in touch if we do not cover this. Asking 1550.00. Please advise urgently. Dev.
